description_en: Queries the list of control policies attached to a resource folder or member account
description_zh: 调用ListControlPolicyAttachmentsForTarget查询资源夹或成员账号绑定的管控策略列表
name: ListControlPolicyAttachmentsForTarget

parameters.help_en:
The target node. Valid values:

Root ID: queries the control policies attached to the Root node.
Resource folder ID: queries the control policies attached to a resource folder.
Member ID: queries the control policies attached to a member
parameters.help_zh:
目标节点。取值：

Root ID：查询Root节点绑定的管控策略。
资源夹ID：查询资源夹绑定的管控策略。
成员ID：查询成员绑定的管控策略
parameters.name: target_id

parameters.help_en:
The language in which the control policy descriptions are returned. Valid values:

zh-CN (default): Chinese.
en: English.
ja: Japanese.

This parameter is valid only for system control policies
parameters.help_zh:
指定返回结果中管控策略描述的语言。取值：

zh-CN（默认值）：中文。
en：英文。
ja：日文。

该参数仅在系统管控策略时有效
parameters.name: language

ControlPolicyAttachment.description_en: The list of attached control policies
ControlPolicyAttachment.description_zh: 已绑定的管控策略列表

items.description_en: The list of attached control policies
items.description_zh: 已绑定的管控策略列表

AttachDate.description_en: The time when the control policy was attached, in RFC 3339 UTC format with Z indicating UTC
AttachDate.description_zh: 绑定管控策略的时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 时间格式，以 Z 表示 UTC

Description.description_en: The description of the control policy

EffectScope.description_en:
The effective scope of the control policy. Valid values:

All: The control policy takes effect on Alibaba Cloud accounts, Resource Access Management (RAM) users, and RAM roles.
RAM: The control policy takes effect only on RAM users and RAM roles
EffectScope.description_zh:
管控策略生效范围。取值：

All：表示该管控策略针对阿里云账号、RAM用户或RAM角色生效。
RAM：表示该管控策略仅针对RAM用户或RAM角色生效

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the control policy

PolicyName.description_en: The name of the control policy

PolicyType.description_en:
The type of the control policy. Valid values:

System: system control policy.
Custom: custom control policy
PolicyType.description_zh:
管控策略类型。取值：

System：系统管控策略。
Custom：自定义管控策略
